description: Defines classes and methods for e2sm_kpm measurement providers in a 5G network context, including support for metrics, test conditions, and measurement data retrieval.

classes.name: e2sm_kpm_cu_meas_provider_impl
classes.description: Implements measurement provider and notifier interfaces for 5G network metrics, supporting data reporting, metric support checks, and UEs filtering.

classes.name: e2sm_kpm_cu_cp_meas_provider_impl
classes.description: Derived class for control plane measurement provider implementation.

classes.name: e2sm_kpm_cu_up_meas_provider_impl
classes.description: Derived class for user plane measurement provider implementation.

methods.name: e2sm_kpm_cu_meas_provider_impl
methods.description: Constructor for the measurement provider class.

methods.name: report_metrics
methods.description: Reports metrics data for PDCP and F1U containers.

methods.name: get_supported_metric_names
methods.description: Returns list of supported metric names at a given level.

methods.name: is_cell_supported
methods.description: Checks if a cell is supported based on its global ID.

methods.name: is_ue_supported
methods.description: Checks if a UE is supported based on its ID.

methods.name: is_test_cond_supported
methods.description: Checks if a test condition type is supported.

methods.name: is_metric_supported
methods.description: Checks if a specific metric with label and level is supported.

methods.name: get_ues_matching_test_conditions
methods.description: Retrieves UEs matching specified test conditions.

methods.name: get_meas_data
methods.description: Retrieves measurement data for specified metrics, labels, UEs, and cell.

methods.name: handle_no_meas_data_available
methods.description: Handles cases where measurement data is unavailable.

methods.name: get_pdcp_reordering_delay_ul
methods.description: Measurement getter for PDCP reordering delay uplink.

methods.name: get_packet_success_rate_ul_gnb_uu
methods.description: Measurement getter for packet success rate uplink GNB-UU.
